Version 1.2 · Updated November 12, 2026

1. About EcoMind
EcoMind is an academic sustainability and learning application developed by the GreenMinds project team as part of a UPC university course. These terms cover account access and the activities, family, community, learning and reward features available in this build. Availability may vary while the project is developed.

2. Accounts and acceptance
Register with information you are authorized to use. Read these terms and the privacy information below before selecting the acceptance checkbox. Keep your password, email verification codes and recovery links private. Your email is used to verify registration and recover access. Sign out after using a shared device. Stopping use of the app does not delete your account; see section 7. If you do not agree, do not complete registration or stop using the account.

3. Children and responsible adults
Children may participate only with the involvement and any legally required authorization of a parent or guardian. School use should be coordinated by a responsible adult. Linking accounts as a family does not verify that a participant is a legal parent or guardian. Selecting Student or Parent is a profile choice; it does not verify age, guardianship or parental authorization. Do not provide information about another child without the necessary authority.

4. Information used by the app
Registration uses a name, email, password and profile role. The server stores a password hash; the app keeps session credentials on the device while you are signed in. Depending on the features you use, the server also keeps profile details, family and friendship relationships, commitments, activity and progress records, points and achievements, community participation, learning preferences and purchase or gem transaction records. Only provide information needed for the activity you choose.

5. Purpose and visibility
These records support account access, verification and recovery, the features you request, progress and rewards, and project validation. Your name, avatar, posts, reactions, shared achievements or participation may be visible to other participants through the relevant family, friend or community features. Do not treat community content as private. Do not publish passwords, recovery links, precise home locations, sensitive information or images of other people without permission. Accepting these terms does not authorize unrelated marketing or unrestricted use of personal images.

6. Service providers and payments
Azure hosts the configured backend and database and processes stored app records. Azure Communication Services Email processes the recipient address and verification or recovery message. Resend may be used if configured in another project environment. Cloudinary processes event images uploaded through the community features. Development versions may record verification codes and recovery tokens in server logs visible to the project team; use test accounts for shared demonstrations. The payment screens in this academic build use a sandbox and have not been validated for real purchases. Do not enter real card or bank account details; use only designated payment test data. Minors must involve their responsible adult. Never send payment details through community posts or support messages.

7. Control of your information
Signing out removes session credentials from this device; it does not erase the server account or shared records. It does not end sessions on other devices or invalidate access credentials already issued by the server before they expire. Contact the project team if you suspect your account or device is compromised. Uninstalling the app also does not erase backend data. This build does not provide a self-service account deletion or data export screen. You may request access, correction or deletion of your information, or object to a use of your information, through the GreenMinds project contact who provided this academic build, using that private course or project channel. Identify the account email, but never send a password, code or recovery link. Requests require manual handling and appropriate identity verification. App data is used for the stated features and academic validation; no fixed automatic deletion schedule for account records is implemented in this build.

8. Participation, content and safety
Treat other participants respectfully. Do not harass, impersonate others, manipulate activity results, misuse accounts or attempt unauthorized access. Complete activities honestly and choose actions that are safe and appropriate for your age and surroundings. Respect the authors, sources and licenses of educational materials and content you share. Activities are educational guidance and do not replace professional safety advice or emergency services.

9. Points, rewards and environmental claims
EcoPoints, gems, streaks, rankings and achievements describe participation within EcoMind. They are not cash, investments or proof of measured environmental savings. Completing an activity does not by itself certify a reduction in water, energy, emissions or waste. Any stated estimate must be interpreted with its source and limitations.

10. Project availability and updates
EcoMind is an academic project and may contain incomplete features, interruptions or errors. Do not use it as the only record of essential information. Updates to these terms will identify their version and date and can be read from registration or your account. Nothing in these terms removes rights that cannot be waived under applicable law. Contact the GreenMinds team through the private project channel used to receive this build for account, privacy or content concerns.
